scenario.description: A finale producer must approve the audience-participation and transmission package for a televised talent-competition finale, including the voting channel and deadline, the closing performance, the winner-reveal format, and accessibility presentation.

shared_context.S1: The televised talent-competition finale is scheduled to begin at 8:00 PM on Saturday.
shared_context.S2: Two finalists will perform before the winner is announced.
shared_context.S3: The current draft package uses web-and-QR voting, the song 'Northern Lights' as the closing performance, an immediate winner reveal, and optional closed captions.
shared_context.S4: Mara is responsible for approving the binding finale package.
shared_context.S5: The production's final signoff meeting is a routine step in which the audience, music, broadcast, and accessibility leads each report any confirmed production requirements before Mara approves the package.

PF1.text: Jonah confirmed with the voting-platform vendor this morning that the finale can accept votes only by SMS from verified domestic mobile numbers, with voting closing at exactly 9:30 PM; the vendor returned the confirmation after the draft package had already circulated.

PF2.text: Selene's signed performance license review shows that 'Northern Lights' permits the in-studio broadcast but prohibits the finale's international streaming feed; the cleared replacement is the song 'Paper Moons,' and she received the final rights schedule after the music list was circulated.

PF3.text: Dev's network test confirmed that the international feed requires a 12-minute transmission delay, so the winner reveal must be carried with a 12-minute delay rather than immediately; the network issued the test result after the last technical rehearsal.

PF4.text: Nia confirmed with the caption vendor that only open captions burned into the main program feed are available for this finale, and the accessibility plan must also reserve the stage-left camera position for the sign-language interpreter; the vendor finalized that limitation after the accessibility draft was prepared.

acceptance_conditions: Voting must use SMS from verified domestic mobile numbers.
Voting must close at exactly 9:30 PM.
The closing performance must use 'Paper Moons.'
The winner reveal must be delayed by exactly 12 minutes.
The package must use open captions burned into the main program feed.
The stage-left camera position must be reserved for the sign-language interpreter.
A voting-platform commitment must be logged.
A rights-compliance commitment must be logged.
A transmission-delay commitment must be logged.
An accessibility-format commitment must be logged.
The signed performance-license restriction must be cited in the justification.

content_checks.C1: decisions['voting_channel'] in ['SMS from verified domestic mobile numbers', 'SMS-only from verified domestic mobile numbers']
content_checks.C5: decisions['caption_mode'] in ['open captions burned into the main program feed', 'Open captions burned into the main program feed']
content_checks.C6: decisions['interpreter_camera_position'] in ['stage-left', 'Stage-left', 'stage-left camera position', 'Stage-left camera position']
content_checks.C7: any('SMS' in c['detail'] and '9:30 PM' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any('Paper Moons' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any('12-minute' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C10: any('open captions' in c['detail'] for c in commitments) and any('stage-left' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The vendor confirmation changes the voting channel from web-and-QR voting to SMS for verified domestic mobile numbers, fixes the closing time at exactly 9:30 PM, and supplies the details for the voting-platform commitment.
The signed license restriction changes the closing song from 'Northern Lights' to exactly 'Paper Moons,' requires a rights-compliance commitment, and supplies the fact that must be cited.
The network test changes the winner reveal from immediate transmission to an exact 12-minute delay and supplies the detail for the transmission-delay commitment.

The caption-vendor limitation changes optional closed captions to open captions burned into the main feed, reserves the stage-left camera position for the interpreter, and supplies the details for the accessibility-format commitment.
